# Convert once to this process's monotonic clock, leaving five seconds to clean up.
RUN_DEADLINE = (
    time.monotonic()
    + min(
        115.0,
        float(os.environ.get("KG_BOUNDED_DEADLINE_UNIX", time.time() + 115))
        - time.time(),
    )
    - 5
)
